title: rpl_stack/mod.rs: bad merge leaves unclosed delimiter (lichen-node won't compile)
description: rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/mod.rs:281-294 — merge commit 3d46a59502 (2026-09-09) spliced two competing RoutePlan return blocks: the first 'return Some(RoutePlan { next_hop, source_route,' is unclosed, then a second competing 'return source_route.first()...' block follows, producing 'mismatched closing delimiter' / 'unclosed delimiter' on direct rustc. cargo check -p lichen-node reports success only because of a stale cached artifact (touch the file and it still passes — cargo is not recompiling). lichen-node genuinely fails to compile from clean. Blocks the lichen-node test suite and any dependent workspace build. Refiled — original P0 bead lost in a store merge.
